newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD auction suspended. [CORRECTED 23:17 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD auction suspended. [CORRECTED 23:17 GMT]

text.p: The Brazilian government on Monday acknowledged that the April 29 auction of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) was suspended following nine court-ordered injunctions, a National Development Bank (BNDES) official said.
(Corrects headline and first paragraph to make clear that court decisions rather than government suspended the CVRD auction.)
"The auction is suspended due to court decisions," said Jose Pio Borges, the BNDES privatization director, adding that the suspension was indefinite.

After his remarks to reporters, Borges told Reuters in a brief interview that the government was reserving the right to try to overturn the injunctions in time to hold the auction at 1000 local time (1300 GMT) Tuesday, as originally planned.
"We still have a few hours," he said.
Borges said the delay, alternatively, might only be for a few days.
Forty-five percent of CVRD's voting shares were due to go on the auction block at the Rio de Janeiro bolsa Tuesday.
